_note: Pre-registered record of the current defaults used by every benchmark run so far. Confidence is core.config.DEFAULT_CONFIDENCE; input_size 640 and YOLO nms_iou 0.7 are the ultralytics predict defaults (the detector never overrides them). RT-DETR is NMS-free, so uses_nms is false and nms_iou is null. sliced is false: the standard arm runs one full-frame pass; the sliced arm is a separate benchmark mode whose tile settings below mirror the core.config.SLICE_* constructor defaults of core.detector.SlicedDetector. This file documents defaults only; it selects nothing.
